name: Bias cutting
summary: The cutting of woven cloth at 45 degrees to the threads, so that it stretches, falls in soft folds and follows the body.
how: Fold the cloth so that the cut line runs at 45 degrees to the warp.
Drape the shape on a small doll, and mark the seams on the true bias.
Hang the cut pieces for a day before the hem is sewn, so that the bias settles.

origin.note: Madeleine Vionnet makes the bias cut the base of a whole line of gowns in the early 1920s.

adoptions.via: The Vionnet workroom cuts evening gowns on the bias; Hollywood costume houses copy the cut for the screen.
